description: PLATEAU's C02 building fixture read with every nesting level extracted as features of their own (buildings, building parts, rooms, boundary and interior wall surfaces, windows and doors), then written back: the writer joins each feature under the object its parent gml:id names, so every nested object's gml:id appears once, under the same parent and wrapper property as in the source, such as window W1 in wall WS1's bldg:opening and door D1 in interior wall IWS1's. New-world only: the legacy writer writes each feature top-level.
